resources.string: Lets GEMA read the post you are looking at

GEMA uses this to read the text on your screen when you tap its button, so it can show you the other side of what you are reading. If a screen exposes no text, it takes a screenshot instead. It only reads when you tap — never in the background — and the text is sent to GEMA\'s server to be analysed. Turn this off at any time to stop it completely.
